facts.text: John and his team won a close basketball game against another team last week.

evidence.quote: The b-ball games have been crazy. We had a real battle against another team last week. It was close until the final buzzer but we got the win.
Thanks! We won! It was really close, but we made it!

facts.text: John described the win as a thrilling and awesome moment that made him love the game more.

evidence.quote: Winning was such a thrill, and it was an awesome moment. These experiences really make me love the game.
Winning must have been so thrilling!

facts.text: John mentioned that winning gives him motivation to keep putting in effort and makes tough times worth it.

evidence.quote: It keeps me motivated to keep putting in the effort and makes all the tough times worth it.
Winning can give us a real confidence boost and makes us keep going with our passions.

facts.text: John shared a photo of a basketball hoop in the sunset with a fence as a reminder of the journey being awesome.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic I took during a morning workout, it's a reminder that the journey can be awesome.
